title_sq: Tek Tulipan Residence, Shitet Apartament 1+1, Me Verande Dhe Oborr !
description_sq: Tek Tulipan Residence Shitet Apartament 1+1, Me Verande dhe Oborr !! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e pare , si dhe ka nje siperfaqe bruto prej 75.74 m2, verande 36.3 m2 dhe oborri 53 m2 . Organizohet nga korridori shperndares, kendi i gatimit se bashku me dhomen e ndenjes me dalje ne verande, dhoma e gjumit dhe tualeti me dritare. Rezidenca dallohet per punime mjaft cilesore dhe moderne. Aktualisht objekti eshte ne faze perfundimtare. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet apartamenti ofron te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme per nje jetese komode dhe te qete. Bashke me apartamentin shitet dhe nje post parkimi me cmim ekstra 25.000 euro.
title_en: At Tulipan Residence, 1+1 apartment for sale, with veranda and yard!
description_en: At Tulipan Residence, 1+1 apartment for sale, with veranda and yard!! The apartment is located on the first floor, and has a gross surface of 75.74 m2, a veranda of 36.3 m2 and a yard of 53 m2. It is organized by the distribution corridor, the kitchen corner together with the living room with access to the veranda, the bedroom and the toilet with a window. The residence stands out for high-quality and modern works. Currently, the object is in the final stage. The area in which the apartment is located offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable and peaceful life. Along with the apartment, a parking post is sold with an extra price of 25,000 euros.
